sections.heading: Behavior and usage
sections.text: Bound the number of check diagnostics. Zero, 65, missing, duplicate and nonnumeric arguments are usage errors.

sections.heading: Exit codes and remediation
sections.text: Exit 0 means this command completed its stated operation; source errors use 1, invalid usage or environment uses 2, and an internal failure uses 101. An emitted file is not runtime proof. Correct the diagnostic and retry; never execute a rejected or partially published artifact. These options belong to check, except the explicitly shared format/color options.

sections.heading: Execution boundary
sections.text: This entry defines syntax, metadata or a restricted profile. It does not introduce a callable constructor. The observations below verify its stated boundary; no source execution is inferred from a catalog entry.
